statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish language with Latin script; no transliteration required for standard names
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Words that may mislead the public (e.g., 'Banco', 'Banco de España')
Protected names requiring prior ministerial approval
Names identical to existing registered companies
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, file administrative appeal within one month to the Registro Mercantil; further judicial review available if appeal denied

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for SL entities if the registered office is properly constituted with a physical address, telephone, and representation meeting legal requirements
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk for unannounced inspections in standard manufacturing setup; routine compliance checks possible

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC): Articles 4 (minimum capital for SL), 20-22 (incorporation deed), 23-28 (statutory content and payment of capital), 30 (registered office), 33 (registration), 36-40 (name certificate), 58-59 and 62 (administration and appointment), 67 (inscription in the Commercial Registry). Complementary rules: Royal Decree 1784/1996 (Commercial Registry Regulations), Law 14/2013 on support for entrepreneurs, and Regulation (EU) 2017/745 for medical devices.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central for the negative name certificate; Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office (e.g., Registro Mercantil de Madrid) for company inscription; notarial intervention through the Colegio Notarial of the chosen district.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (public incorporation deed) containing the estatutos sociales, followed by inscription in the Registro Mercantil Provincial and application for NIF through the Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) using Modelo 036/037.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada: minimum share capital EUR 3,000 (approx. USD 3,270), fully subscribed and paid up in cash before execution of the deed. The contribution is deposited in a temporary blocked bank account in the name of the company in formation; the bank certificate of deposit is released only at notarial execution. No separate statutory escrow holding period applies. Non-cash contributions require an independent expert valuation report attached to the deed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the founding shareholders, that: (1) the Company's issued share capital of EUR 3,000 is fully subscribed and paid in, as certified by bank deposit; (2) the registered office is fixed at [address], Madrid, Spain, where statutory books and records will be kept; (3) [Name] is appointed Administrador and [Name] Secretary, each for an indefinite term until removed; (4) the Administrador is authorised to open bank accounts and to file all tax, registry, Social Security, AEMPS and licensing applications; (5) this resolution is effective immediately and a signed copy shall be entered in the minutes book.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Negative Name Certificate – Company Denomination Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central / CIRCE electronic single window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application for up to three preferred corporate names to the Registro Mercantil Central, either directly or through the CIRCE/entrepreneur support portal. Pay the applicable online certification fee. The registry certifies that the requested denomination is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing company. Retain the certificate for inclusion in the public deed.
required_dossiers: DNI/NIE or passport copy of each founding partner
Power of attorney if a representative acts
Optional draft bylaws to confirm proposed name and object
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as coinciding with an existing denomination, refile with alternative proposed names. If the rejection appears unfounded, submit written allegations and an administrative recourse before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Deposit of Paid-In Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit entity licensed by Banco de España
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary account in the name of the company in formation. Deposit at least EUR 3,000 and instruct the bank to issue a certificate identifying the account holder, amount, and blocked status for the incorporation. Do not release the funds before notarial execution.
required_dossiers: Anti-money-laundering forms and beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires additional KYC information, supply source-of-funds documentation and updated beneficial-ownership details. If the deposit certificate contains errors, obtain a corrected certificate before proceeding to the notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Public Incorporation Deed and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary in the notarial district of the registered office (e.g., Ilustre Colegio Notarial de Madrid)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the name certificate, bank deposit certificate, draft estatutos sociales, and shareholders' identification to the notary. The notary verifies legal capacity, object legality, and capital payment, then executes the escritura de constitución. The notary delivers the first copy and a digital certificate for subsequent registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a deficiency, correct the documents before signature. If the deed has already been granted, execute a notarial rectification deed (escritura de subsanación) to cure defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Impuesto sobre Actos Jurídicos Documentados (AJD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Tributaria de la Comunidad Autónoma of the registered office (e.g., Agencia Tributaria de Madrid)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Modelo 600 electronically or at the regional tax office, declaring the notarial document and paying the applicable AJD rate on the capital value. Obtain the stamped model and payment receipt for submission to the Commercial Registry.
required_dossiers: First copy of the incorporation deed
Provisional NIF or evidence of Modelo 036 filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office raises a query, file a corrected Modelo 600 or provide the requested deed certification. Late filing requires a complementary declaration with late-payment interest.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Provisional NIF and Census Registration with AEAT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – Sede Electrónica
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete Modelo 036 (censo de empresarios, profesionales y retenedores) and request a provisional NIF for the company using the first copy of the deed. The tax agency assigns the provisional NIF before Commercial Registry inscription. After inscription, apply for the definitive NIF with the registry certificate.
required_dossiers: Authorization for electronic receipt of notices
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected for a data mismatch, correct and refile Modelo 036. If the request remains unpaid or unanswered, submit an urgent processing request or obtain a receipt certificate and escalate to the tax office of the registered office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office (e.g., Registro Mercantil de Madrid)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation deed electronically using the Interactive Presentation System or in paper at the Provincial Registry, together with the liquidated AJD form and provisional NIF. The registrar verifies legal and formal compliance and enters the company in the registry, after which the company acquires full legal personality.
required_dossiers: First copy of the notarial incorporation deed
Certificate of administrator acceptance if not included in the deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a note of defects (calificación), submit a written cure by rectifying the deed, completing the missing documents, or filing a recurso gubernativo before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within the statutory period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration and Preliminary Sectoral Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS); Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios (AEMPS); municipality and regional industry department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer with TGSS to obtain a Social Security account code before hiring staff. Concurrently pre-file the medical device manufacturing establishment registration dossier with AEMPS and apply for the municipal activity/opening licence for the assembly and calibration premises. The licenses must be obtained before commencement of manufacturing operations.
required_dossiers: AEMPS manufacturing establishment application and technical documentation under EU MDR 2017/745
Municipal licence application and environmental registration/screening if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If TGSS rejects the employer registration, correct the worker census data and refile. If AEMPS requests additional conformity evidence, supplement the technical file within the suspension period. If the municipality issues deficiency notices, complete the corrections and resubmit before the permit lapses.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección General de Industria, Energía y Minas of the autonomous community where the facility is located; Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo for industrial coordination; Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios (AEMPS) for the medical device manufacturing establishment registration under EU Regulation 2017/745.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de actividad / licencia de apertura of the manufacturing and calibration establishment, together with AEMPS registration as 'establecimiento fabricante de productos sanitarios' (medical device manufacturer establishment registration) under EU MDR 2017/745.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the autonomous community (e.g., Consejería de Medio Ambiente, Agricultura e Interior of Comunidad de Madrid), coordinated with the Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category: environmental communication/registration and simplified environmental screening; full EIA report is not required for low-impact electronic monitor assembly and calibration unless the activity exceeds thresholds under Annex I of Law 21/2013 or generates substantial hazardous waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to public sewer must comply with Real Decreto 817/2015 quality parameters and municipal sewer regulations; VOC emissions from cleaning solvents must meet Real Decreto 117/2003 and BAT conclusions under Directive 2010/75/EU; hazardous waste from calibration chemicals and spent batteries must be managed under Law 7/2022; electrical medical safety and electromagnetic compatibility must comply with UNE-EN 60601 series standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Municipal fire safety certificate (certificado de protección contra incendios), building structural load and code compliance certificate (ITE / licencia de segunda ocupación or equivalent), valid low-voltage electrical installation certificate under REBT, and occupational risk prevention plan under Ley 31/1995 and Real Decreto 486/1997, including workplace health and safety clearance and medical surveillance before operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – portal: sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must appoint a Spanish fiscal representative (for non-EU residents) or directly apply for a CIF/NIF before commencing economic activity. The application is submitted via AEAT Form 030 (censo de empresarios, profesionales y retenedores) together with incorporation deed, Spanish notarial power of attorney, and foreign tax residence certificate. Provisional NIF assigned; definitive NIF granted once the SL is registered in the Mercantile Registry and the corresponding Form 036/037 update is filed. VAT registration is integrated via the same census process, with a separate high-Volume operator status where applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election. Spanish SL is a taxable entity under Impuesto sobre Sociedades. Optional regimes available: group taxation under special consolidated tax regime (Régimen de consolidación fiscal), reduced tax rate for newly created entities (first two years with positive tax base, 25% for tax years 2023-2024 per current transitional rules; standard 25% thereafter), and the tax transparency / partnership look-through rules are limited to civil partnerships and certain joint ventures. Hybrid mismatch elections follow EU ATAD directives, requiring disclosure and potential adjustment; no elective pass-through status for an SL.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido) – Value Added Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general monetary registration threshold for VAT. Any entity conducting business activities in Spain, including intra-EU distance sales exceeding EUR 10,000 (2023 threshold), must register for IVA before making taxable supplies. Foreign non-established suppliers are subject to registration regardless of volume when the place of supply is in Spain.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Since 1 January 2024, e-invoicing is mandatory in B2B transactions between Spanish established businesses and suppliers, with full implementation by 2025 for all enterprises with annual turnover above EUR 8 million (shorter deadlines) and by 2026 for others, per Ley 18/2022 and the 'Crea y Crece' law, requiring issuance via technological platforms using a structured XML format. However, immediate real-time fiscal clearance (mandatory prior SSR/declaration to AEAT) is not universal; the 'Suministro Inmediato de Información (SII)' regime requires large businesses (turnover over EUR 6 million, or VAT group filers) to submit invoice records to AEAT within 8 days of issuance (4 days for SII special reinforced). Spain's upcoming 'Verifactura' regime will enlarge near-real-time digital reporting. Digital stamping is not required, but invoices must include a QR code and structured electronic format when e-invoicing is used.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to third countries (outside EU) are zero-rated under Article 21 of the Spanish VAT Law, provided the goods physically leave the EU within the legal export procedure, accompanied by a valid customs export declaration and proof of transport. Intra-EU dispatches to a VAT-registered customer with a valid VIES number are also zero-rated under Article 25. Services linked to exported goods (e.g., transport, ancillary services) may likewise be zero-rated. For the medical device product category (multi-parameter telemetry monitors), zero-rating applies only to physical export of goods; no taxable supply in Spain arises if title transfers with export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Documento Único Administrativo / DUA) accepted by Agencia Tributaria
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing export
Proof of exit from the EU (e.g., departure stamp, CMR, terminal receipt)
Inward Remittance Certificate from a Spanish bank showing receipt of foreign currency
Commercial invoice and purchase order referencing the export transaction
For intra-EU: VIES compliant sales list and customer's valid VAT number confirmation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT conducts dedicated refund and audit controls. Absence of proof of export within the deadlines, false declarations, or missing Foreign Exchange repatriation documentation triggers disallowance of zero-rating, resulting in VAT due at 21% with late-payment interest. Deliberate fraudulent claims constitute tax infringement (infracción grave) with penalties ranging from 50% to 150% of the omitted VAT. Failure to comply with SII/e-invoicing obligations is subject to EUR 500 per certificate or invoice omitted, up to 10,000 euros. In aggravated cases, criminal tax fraud liability may arise when the defrauded amount exceeds EUR 120,000 per tax year.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), operating within the Eurosystem and the European System of Central Banks; foreign-investment statistical registrar: Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (DGCIIN) of the Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current- and capital-account convertibility under Article 63 TFEU and Law 19/2003 on Capital Movements; the euro is a freely convertible reserve currency and no exchange licensing, prior approval (except for investments by EU/blacklisted tax-haven residents exceeding EUR 3,000,000, which require a prior declaration under RD 664/1999) or surrender obligations apply. Profit remittance hurdles: dividends require a shareholders' resolution and mercantile-registry inscription, then are subject to 19% non-resident withholding tax under RDL 5/2004 unless reduced by an applicable tax treaty, with quarterly Form 216/296 filings by the SL; no central-bank transfer authorization is needed.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirement or mandatory conversion ratio exists; export receipts may be retained in EUR or any freely convertible currency. Royal Decree 1816/1991 (Economic Transactions with the Foreign Sector) imposes an 18-month statutory deadline from shipment date for collection of goods-trade receivables from non-EEA counterparties, beyond which prior DGCIIN authorization is required; supporting trade documentation must be retained for five years.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Capital) / Operational Account (Cuenta Operativa)
Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Capital) / Operational Account (Cuenta Operativa)
Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Capital) / Operational Account (Cuenta Operativa)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium (conditional) feasibility. EEA-authorized EMIs and credit institutions passported under PSD2/CRD IV (e.g., Qonto, Revolut Business, N26, Monese) may open EUR IBAN accounts remotely for the Spanish SL. Legal constraints: EMIs cannot issue or confirm letters of credit, are not covered by the Spanish Deposit Guarantee Fund (FOGADE), cannot hold client funds as deposits beyond the e-money float limits, and are unsuitable as the escrow bank for statutory paid-in capital attestation (certificado de depósito) before a notary; use only as a secondary operational collection and FX-batching rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is required at most Tier-1 Spanish banks for the SL legal representative (administrador único or mancomunado), who must appear in branch with a valid passport, Spanish NIE, and the notarial deed of appointment; video-KYC is only occasionally accepted for EEA-resident directors. Non-resident shareholders need not appear personally and may act through a Spanish notarized power of attorney (poder general), but the capital-escrow account opening in Santander, BBVA, or CaixaBank standardly mandates an in-branch interview with the beneficial-owner representative under AML Law 10/2010 before the account is activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders from FATF grey-listed or high-risk jurisdictions holding more than 25% of the SL's share capital.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificates of incorporation, good standing, and directors of each foreign corporate shareholder; beneficial-ownership extract from the Registro de Titularidades Reales; audited financial statements and tax returns proving source of wealth; bank reference letters from prior relationship banks; and a written commercial-rationale statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque multi-layer ownership (trusts or intermediate shells) obscuring the ultimate natural person behind the ECG-monitor business.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete organizational chart to ultimate individual UBOs; trust deeds or foundation statutes; CRS and tax-residence declarations of each intermediate entity; statutory declarations (declaración jurada) of all nominee directors; and written representation prohibiting bearer shares or silent holders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low paid-in capital (EUR 3,000 statutory minimum for an SL under Law 1/2010) against projected high export turnover of medical devices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month treasury and cash-flow model; signed purchase orders or distribution agreements for patient monitors; working-capital and inventory plan; CE-marking (EU MDR 2017/745) Notified Body certificate or pending AEMPS registration receipt; and warehouse or logistics lease evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pending or newly applied statutory license under EU MDR 2017/745, which could indicate unregulated commercial activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: AEMPS (Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios) application file reference; Declaration of Conformity and technical documentation; ISO 13485 quality-management certificate; and the post-market surveillance plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume non-EU trade flows suggesting possible trade-based money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master supply agreements with Latin American distributors; standard incoterms on pro-forma invoices; consistent shipping set (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, CMR); UBO-matched payment records; and monthly treasury reconciliation pack.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route via SWIFT MT103 (for USD, via CHIPS/Fedwire correspondent), or SEPA Credit Transfer (for EUR intra-EEA), or correspondent-bank telegraphic transfer to the SL's Spanish IBAN (BIC). The remittance/information field must state the balance-of-payments purpose code 'EC100 – Aportaciones de capital' and reference 'Aportación de capital – escritura [date]' with the SL NIF. Verification: (1) capital deposit certificate (certificado de depósito) issued by the receiving Spanish bank to support the notarial deed; (2) notarial public deed of incorporation or capital increase inscribed in the Registro Mercantil; (3) post-statistical foreign-investment declaration filed with DGCIIN within one month; (4) prior declaration (declaración previa) only if the investor is resident in an EU non-cooperative tax-haven jurisdiction and the amount exceeds EUR 3,000,000; (5) valid NIE and Spanish tax ID for each non-resident shareholder before disbursement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 for telegraphic transfer of supplier invoices and distributor payments. Documentary trade: irrevocable confirmed Commercial Letter of Credit (UCP 600) issued via SWIFT MT700/MT707, with presentation documents per L/C terms (commercial invoice, packing list, transport document, insurance policy, EC Certificate of Free Sale); SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst) for urgent EUR payments to EU component suppliers; SWIFT MT202 for interbank coverage of multi-currency transactions. All outbound transfers require underlying trade documents retained five years; exports to non-EU destinations are 0% VAT-exempt with MRN customs exit proof, and intra-community supplies are 0% VAT with VIES (ECSL) registration.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forwards (outright FXA) in EUR/USD, EUR/CNY, and EUR/GBP, fixed against ECB/Euro foreign-exchange reference rates, documented under ISDA Master Agreement with CSA, subject to EMIR trade reporting and mandatory clearing for standardized contracts via LCH or CME; underlying real commercial exposure required.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on non-convertible Latin American and African currencies (EUR/ARS, EUR/VES, EUR/NGN, EUR/PKR), offered by Spanish credit institutions as 'seguros de cambio' under RD 1816/1991, cash-settled in EUR, requiring documentary evidence of genuine trade exposure in the patient-monitor supply chain.

Cross-Currency Swaps (XCCY/CCS) between EUR and USD/CNY aligned with the ECG-monitor procurement cycle; standardized swaps cleared via LCH Ltd. or CME, bespoke maturities bilateral, both subject to ISDA/EMIR margining, CRR prudential limits, and CNMV conduct supervision.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Accounts (Cuentas Anuales): balance sheet, P&L, statement of changes in equity, cash flow statement, and notes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil of the company's province (Commercial Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: AGM must approve within 6 months of FYE (30 June for 31-Dec FYE); deposit within 1 month after approval, i.e., by 30 July (practical deadline 31 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Commercial Registry closes the company's folio, blocking all further registrations (CCom art. 282); BORME publication after 2 consecutive missed years (art. 283); possible administrative fines up to EUR 12,000 and eventual strike-off for prolonged default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Modelo 200) and annual settlement for Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: AEAT – Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1–25 July for calendar-year taxpayers (25 days after the 6-month post-year-end period)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharges of 5%–20% plus late-payment interest (LGT art. 27); fines under arts. 191/198 LGT up to 100% of the tax understated; enforcement proceedings for unpaid balances.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1–30 January of the year following the calendar year; not required for SII-registered large taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of 5%–20% plus interest on arrears (art. 27 LGT); fines under art. 199 LGT (EUR 150–EUR 10,000); VAT recalculation risk under audit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual withholding recaps: Modelo 190 (employment income), Modelo 180 (rental income), Modelo 123 (investment income), Modelo 115 (urban lease rentals paid)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1–31 January of the year following the calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or false filing: recargo 5%–20% plus interest; fines from EUR 150 per data item up to EUR 10,000 (arts. 198–199 LGT); 100% penalty on undisclosed withholding amounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Third-Party Transactions Return (Modelo 347) when aggregate transactions with any counterparty exceed EUR 3,005.06
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the last day of February (28/29 February) of the year following the calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 1% of undeclared net amounts, minimum EUR 150, maximum EUR 10,000 (art. 260 LGT); late-filing surcharge of 5%–20% plus interest.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual related-party information return (Modelo 232) when related-party transactions exceed EUR 250,000 per counterparty
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1–25 July, aligned with Modelo 200 for calendar-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under art. 199 LGT (EUR 150–EUR 10,000); documentation penalties for transfer pricing non-compliance up to 15% of the related-party amounts (art. 18 LIS).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalization (digital) of statutory corporate and accounting books: Libro Diario, Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales, Libro de Actas, and Libro Registro de Socios
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal-year end, i.e., by 30 April for a 31-Dec FYE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlegalized books lose evidential value in court; the Commercial Registry may refuse the next annual accounts deposit and record the non-compliance; no automatic fine, but registry blocking persists until regularized.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Update and confirmation of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (Registro de Titulares Reales) and shareholding structure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 business days after any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership; reconfirmed with the annual Deposit of Annual Accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry refusal of the annual accounts deposit or subsequent filings until UBO records are aligned; fines under Law 10/2010 (up to EUR 60,000 for serious, EUR 100,000–EUR 1,000,000 for very serious infringements); share transfer deed cannot be registered until UBO update is completed.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit mandatory when the SL meets at least two of the following conditions for two consecutive fiscal years: total assets > EUR 2,850,000; net turnover > EUR 5,700,000; average number of employees > 50 (art. 263 Ley de Sociedades de Capital). Audit also always required for subsidiaries of consolidated groups, listed companies, and financial/insurance intermediaries. A shareholder holding >=5% of the capital may request the appointment of an auditor at the annual meeting, forcing an audit even below thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General Contable, R.D. 1514/2007 as amended by R.D. 1/2021); micro-enterprise PGC (R.D. 1515/2007) available for entities under its size thresholds; consolidated accounts of listed groups follow EU-endorsed IFRS. All statutory financial statements are presented in EUR.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spain does not impose a standalone annual UBO declaration. Under Law 10/2010 and R.D. 304/2014, the SL must maintain an internal UBO record, update the Commercial Registry's electronic Registro de Titulares Reales within 15 business days of any ownership or control change, and reconfirm UBO data in the annual Deposit of Annual Accounts. Transfers of SL participations require a notarized public deed, registration in the Libro Registro de Socios, and payment of transfer tax before the UBO update is accepted by the Registry.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios) – compulsory for all SLs
Shareholders' Minute Book (Libro de Actas) – compulsory for all SLs
Related-party contracts book (Libro de Contratos con el Socio Único or con socios/administradores) – mandatory for single-member SLs and when contracts with directors/shareholders are executed
Legalized accounting books (Libro Diario; Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales) – kept at the registered office
Internal UBO record (Registro interno de Titularidad Real) – updated within 15 business days of any change

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $540 – $1,620 per year (EUR 500–1,500), covering registered office provision, corporate secretarial support, annual accounts preparation, and registry filings
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $5,500 – $15,000 per year for an ICAC-registered auditor, reflecting a manufacturing SL with export sales, inventory, and intercompany transactions
